name: Email Ownership
summary: Describes whether an email address is absent, asserted, or verified as owned by the identity being resolved.

values.name: Asserted
values.summary: An email was supplied but ownership is not verified.

values.name: Verified
values.summary: Ownership of the canonical email was verified.

values.name: Provider Verified
values.summary: A trusted provider asserted and verified the email.

values.name: Conflict
values.summary: Verified or asserted emails conflict and require resolution.

sourceReferences.note: RegisteredEmail, VerifiedEmail, and provider email are distinct
